after.title: Pilot commercial email worker
after.description: A checked worker rotates opaque outbox signals and validates current document and recipient authority within the existing bound claim transaction.

responsibilities.LP-10: Use a dedicated worker login and exact committed delivery claims.
responsibilities.LP-12: Keep source reads tenant scoped and worker credentials free of table grants.

gaps: Independent RED review and deployment-specific evidence remain required.
